title: பரிவர்த்தனை யோகம் ஏமாற்றம் தரும் (Parivarthanai Disappointment / Change of Outcome)
description: In D.S.Astro System, Parivarthanai (both sign and constellation exchange) yields initial disappointment, changing expected courses or requiring pivoting to an alternative result.

title: கல்வியில் பரிவர்த்தனை (Education Branch Pivot)
description: Exchange involving Mercury or 4th/5th house leads to studying a major different from the originally desired field.
